Subject: Lumen Labs: onboarding compliance items for PO setup

Hi Julian,

Thanks for moving quickly on onboarding. Procurement flagged a few mandatory artifacts before we can issue a PO and route invoices: 

1) Signed DPA (DocuSign)
2) Current SOC 2 report or link to host
3) Full subprocessor inventory (CSV or spreadsheet)
4) Completed W-9 (for US vendors)

I attached our procurement checklist to illustrate the sequence we follow. High-level flow: once the DPA is fully executed and we have a W-9 and invoice remit info, procurement will create a PO (format: RW-LL-8472-<year>) and share the PO number for you to reference on invoices.

Can you confirm the following by EOD Monday?
- Are you able to sign our DPA via DocuSign?
- Link to SOC 2 or a PDF we can download
- Subprocessor inventory (CSV preferred)
- Billing remit contact and AP email for invoice submission

Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

If anything on our end needs adjustment (payment terms, specific fields on the W-9), flag it and I’ll loop in procurement.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference

Appreciate the quick turnaround, Julian — this is exactly what procurement needs. Next steps and a few housekeeping items: 

- DPA: I’m sending the DocuSign envelope from procurement now (link below). Please sign both signature blocks. Once fully executed we’ll attach the signed DPA to the vendor record and proceed with PO creation.
  DocuSign: https://redwood.docusign.com/documents/REQ-8923

- SOC 2: we’ll review the report; procurement/security may reach out with a few clarifying questions (redaction is fine for sensitive material).

- Subprocessor list: received. Procurement asks that the CSV includes a column for data regions (US/EU/APAC) — if you can add that in a follow-up, that would be great.

- W-9: good to have. We will forward the W-9 to Finance.

PO & invoicing guidance (please follow exactly):
- We will create PO RW-LL-8472-2028 once DPA is executed and W-9 is on file.
- Invoice header should include: Redwood Inference (Bill To), PO number, invoice date, line item descriptions, and your remit address.
- Submit invoices to: ap.accounts@redwood.inference.com AND cc: ap@lumenlabs.co
- Payment terms: standard net-30 unless otherwise negotiated. If you require different terms, state them here and we’ll escalate.

CC’ing Karthik and Ben to note the vendor acceptance and confirm there are no open security blockers.

Thanks — please reply when the DPA is signed and I’ll confirm the PO creation timeline.

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Enterprise Procurement Lead
Redwood Inference
